title: Sardinian elders dug up giant bones with jewellery

tellings.quote: I interviewed dozens of people in Sardinia who who had dug up the bones of giants themselves with their hands.

plain: Tim Alberino, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he interviewed dozens of older people on Sardinia, an Italian island, who told him they had dug up the bones of giants with their own hands, along with jewellery, sometime between the 1930s and 1960s. He credits a researcher named Steve Quayle in connection with the story. If true, it would mean very tall humans once lived there.
